## Loading and formatting dataset {.tabset}

### load dataset
```{r load_dataset}

# load dataset
kaede.seurat <- LoadH5Seurat("saves/kaede_imputed.h5Seurat")

kaede.seurat # 16,665 genes across 12,843 cells

DefaultAssay(kaede.seurat) <- "originalexp"
```

### Clean and filter dataset for just NK cells at 48hours

```{r filter_dataset}

# clean dataset, keep only 48 hour timepoint as this is by far the timepoint with majority of the cells both red and green 

table(kaede.seurat@meta.data$celltype_cluster_paper, kaede.seurat@meta.data$time)


##############################
# keep only 48 hour timepoint
##############################
Idents(kaede.seurat) <- kaede.seurat@meta.data$time
unique(Idents(kaede.seurat))


kaede.seurat.NK <- subset(kaede.seurat, idents = c("Green_48h", "Red_48h"))


##############################
# remove ILC1 and NKT populations 
##############################
Idents(kaede.seurat.NK) <- kaede.seurat.NK@meta.data$celltype_cluster_paper
unique(Idents(kaede.seurat.NK))


kaede.seurat.NK <- subset(kaede.seurat.NK, idents = c("ILC", "NKT"), invert = TRUE)

# clean environment
rm(kaede.seurat)
gc()
```


### DEG analysis
```{r DEG_analyis}
Idents(kaede.seurat.NK) <- kaede.seurat.NK@meta.data$time
unique(Idents(kaede.seurat.NK))


early.markers <- FindMarkers(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                             ident.1 = "Green_48h", 
                             ident.2 = "Red_48h",
                             min.pct = 0.1)

goi <- early.markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::top_n(50, avg_log2FC) %>%
  rownames()

early.markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))
goi


scCustomize::Stacked_VlnPlot(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                             features = goi,
                             pt.size = 0,
                             group.by = "time")




# gene signature 
cd160.sig <- read.csv("data/CD160_DEG_QLF_S.PosvsNeg.csv")

pos.sig <- cd160.sig %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::top_n(50, logFC) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(genes)

pos.sig



kaede.seurat.NK <- AddModuleScore(kaede.seurat.NK,
                                  features = list(cd160sig = pos.sig), 
                                  name = "CD160_sig")


head(kaede.seurat@meta.data)
VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                 features = "CD160_sig1", 
                 group.by = "celltype_cluster_paper")


VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                 features = "CD160_sig1", 
                 group.by = "time")




VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                 features = "Acat2", 
                 group.by = "time")


RidgePlot(kaede.seurat.NK, 
          features = "CD160_sig1", 
          group.by = "time")


# IFN-signalling signature 
kaede.seurat.NK




```



### DGAT expression
```{r DGAT_expression}


goi <- c("Nkg7", "Itga1", "Itga2", "Dgat1", "Dgat2")

scCustomize::Stacked_VlnPlot(kaede.seurat, 
                             features = goi,
                             pt.size = 0,
                             group.by = "time")

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "Vlnplot_kaede_grouped_by_colour_dgat.pdf"))
dev.off()


Idents(kaede.seurat) <- kaede.seurat@meta.data$celltype_cluster_paper
temp.seurat <- subset(kaede.seurat, idents = c("NK_1", "NK_2", "NK_5"))
scCustomize::Stacked_VlnPlot(temp.seurat, 
                             features = goi,
                             pt.size = 0.1,
                             group.by = "celltype_cluster_paper")

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "Vlnplot_kaede_select_NK_groups_dgat.pdf"))
dev.off()





```
